Search Query: I'm currently working on a project. I don't know examples of what Electronic Health Records look like. What NLP techniques might I be using on data like this? What subgroups in CDC WONDER data would I be abstracting? How could I apply this to look at prevalence rates of autoimmune diseases? What skills should I brush up on?
